topology_note: SW1 trunk Gi0/1 to SW2 trunk Gi0/1. VLAN 50 (Engineering, 10.10.50.0/24) was recently added. File server on SW1 Fa0/15 in VLAN 50.
expected_fault: VLAN 50 is not in the allowed VLAN list on the trunk port Gi0/1 (only VLANs 1, 10, 20 are allowed), so VLAN 50 traffic cannot cross between SW1 and SW2.
